name: Magazine editorial
idea: A serif magazine spread: big quotes, columns, photographs with captions.
brief: A magazine feature. The display serif is the voice: large, elegant, with real contrast between headline and text sizes. Use editorial moments: a pull quote set huge, a drop-in kicker in the label face, text in one or two narrow columns, a caption under an image. Images sit half-bleed or full-bleed, edge to edge on one side, never floating in a box. Thin hairlines (1-2px) may separate a caption or a kicker; nothing heavier. White space is the luxury.

styles: editorial documentary photography, natural light, shallow depth of field
